usageNotes: Use this to audit recent or in-progress tasks on a managed PVE remote — either across the entire cluster (omit `node`) or scoped to a single node. Requires `Resource.Audit` privilege on the target remote. Each returned item includes a UPID that can be passed to task-log or task-status endpoints to retrieve full output.

examples.summary: List all tasks on a specific node of a managed PVE remote

tips: Omitting `node` returns tasks across all nodes in the remote cluster — useful for a global view but may return a large result set.
The `status` field is optional in responses; a missing status typically means the task is still running.
Use the `upid` from each result with a task-log or task-status call to inspect output or wait for completion.
The `remote` identifier must match a configured PDM remote name exactly (2–32 chars, alphanumeric/dot/dash/underscore).
